name: 03-domain-logic
description: Whether the domain component is really prompt-visible and composable. The held-out cases pin values only chief.domain can produce, so a model that answers from arithmetic of its own gets them wrong.

cases.name: observed-hiring-decision
cases.description: The chapter's question: model both options, forecast, score a decision matrix, recommend one.

input.task: Should we hire 3 senior engineers at $200k or 5 junior engineers at $130k? Model the hiring impact of each option, forecast ARR for the next 12 months at 15% monthly growth to see when revenue covers the new burn, and run a decision matrix over both options on cost, productivity, time_to_impact, team_growth and runway_impact (score them 1-10 yourself, justify the scores). Recommend one option with the numbers that support it.

cases.name: held-out-hiring-impact
cases.description: chief.domain/hiring-impact for 4 engineers at $150,000: 10,000,000 / 565,000 = 17.7 months, a 2.3 month reduction, MODERATE RISK.

input.task: Call chief.domain/hiring-impact for 4 engineers at an annual salary of $150,000 and return exactly the map it produces, unchanged.
